on failure it returns a `ToolResponse` whose `result` describes the failure, and the executor is never invoked ([validated by: returns a ToolResponse naming the missing required field and does not invoke the executor @beecb068](../../src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts#L10)).\n  validated by : returns a ToolResponse naming the missing required field and does not invoke the executor (src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts:10)\n  --- src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts:10-49\n    it('returns a ToolResponse naming the missing required field and does not invoke the executor', async () => {\n      let executorCalls = 0;\n      const registry = new ToolRegistry();\n      registry.register(\n        {\n          name: 'weather',\n          description: 'get weather',\n          inputSchema: {type: 'object', required: ['location'], properties: {location: {type: 'string'}}},\n        },\n        async () => {\n          executorCalls++;\n          return 'sunny';\n        }\n      );\n  \n      const toolResponse = await registry.execute('weather', {});\n  \n      expect({toolResult: toolResponse.result, executorCalls}).toEqual({\n        toolResult: expect.stringMatching(/location/),\n        executorCalls: 0,\n      });\n    });\n  \n    it('passes valid input with an extra property through to the executor unchanged', async () => {\n      const received: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];\n      const registry = new ToolRegistry();\n      registry.register(\n        {\n          name: 'echo',\n          description: 'echoes input',\n          inputSchema: {type: 'object', required: ['city'], properties: {city: {type: 'string'}}},\n        },\n        async input => {\n          received.push(input);\n          return 'ok';\n   \n</document>\n</section>\n</context>"}

{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":"2026-11-15T15:04:52.111Z","tool_name":"replace","tool_id":"replace__call_2174025728543003670","parameters":{"file_path":"/var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/40ff4f589217/workspace/target/src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts","instruction":"Switch ajv loading to createRequire with structural types compatible with both ajv v8 and v6, validate input in ToolRegistry.execute before invoking the executor without leaking values, add the one-line doc comment on execute, and attach cause to the error thrown in compileSchema.","old_string":"import {Ajv} from 'ajv';\nimport type {SchemaObject, ValidateFunction} from 'ajv';\nimport type {ToolDefinition} from '../../types/ai.js';\nimport type {OutgoingMessage} from '../../types/messages.js';\nimport {log} from '../../shared/logger.js';\n\nconst ajv = new Ajv({strict: false, validateFormats: false});","new_string":"import {createRequire} from 'node:module';\nimport type {ToolDefinition} from '../../types/ai.js';\nimport type {OutgoingMessage} from '../../types/messages.js';\nimport {log} from '../../shared/logger.js';\n\ninterface AjvErrorItem {\n  instancePath?: string;\n  dataPath?: string;\n  keyword: string;\n  params: Record<string, unknown>;\n  message?: string;\n}\n\ninterface AjvValidator {\n  (candidate: unknown): boolean;\n  errors?: AjvErrorItem[] | null;\n}\n\ninterface AjvInstance {\n  compile(schema: Record<string, unknown>): AjvValidator;\n}\n\ntype AjvConstructor = new (options: Record<string, unknown>) => AjvInstance;\n\nconst loadModule = createRequire(import.meta.url);\nconst Ajv = loadModule('ajv') as AjvConstructor;\nconst ajv = new Ajv({strict: false, validateFormats: false});"}}

[]);\n  }\n\n  has(name: string): boolean {\n    return this.tools.has(name);\n  }\n\n  /** Validates input against inputSchema before executing; see specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md. */\n  async execute(name: string, input: Record<string, unknown>, context?: ToolContext): Promise<ToolResponse> {\n    const tool = this.tools.get(name);\n    if (!tool) {\n      log.warn('tool', 'tool not found', {name});\n      throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);\n    }\n    const validate = this.resolveValidator(tool);\n    const valid = validate(input);\n    if (!valid) {\n      const reason = formatValidationFailure(name, validate.errors ?? []);\n      log.warn('tool', 'invalid tool input', {name, reason});\n      return {result: reason};\n    }\n    log.info('tool', 'executing', {name, inputKeys: Object.keys(input)});\n    const rawResult = await tool.execute(input, context);\n    const response = normalizeToolResponse(rawResult);\n    log.info('tool', 'execution complete', {\n      name,\n      rawType: typeof rawResult,\n      clientMessageCount: response.clientMessages?.length ?? 0,\n      clientMessageTypes: response.clientMessages?.map(m => m.type) ?? [],\n      suppressAssistantResponse: response.suppressAssistantResponse ?? false,\n    });\n    return response;\n  }\n\n  private resolveValidator(tool: StoredTool): AjvValidator {\n    if (tool.validator) return tool.validator;\n    const resolved = this.resolveDefinition(tool.definitionSource);\n    const cached = this.dynamicValidators.get(resolved.inputSchema);\n    if (cached) return cached;\n    const compiled = compileSchema(resolved.name, resolved.inputSchema);\n    this.dynamicValidators.set(resolved.inputSchema, compiled);\n    return compiled;\n  }\n}\n\nfunction compileSchema(toolName: string, inputSchema: Record<string, unknown>): AjvValidator {\n  try {\n    return ajv.compile(inputSchema);\n  } catch (error) {\n    const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\n    throw new Error(`Invalid inputSchema for tool \"${toolName}\": ${reason}`, {cause: error});\n  }\n}\n\nfunction formatValidationFailure(toolName: string, errors: AjvErrorItem[]): string {\n  const details = errors.map(formatAjvError);\n  const summary = details.length > 0 ? details.join('; ') : 'input failed schema validation';\n  return `Invalid input for tool \"${toolName}\": ${summary}`;\n}\n\nfunction formatAjvError(error: AjvErrorItem): string {\n  const basePath = normalizeAjvPath(error.instancePath ?? error.dataPath ?? '');\n  const {params} = error;\n  if (error.keyword === 'required') {\n    const missing = String(params.missingProperty ?? '');\n    const fieldPath = basePath ? `${basePath}.${missing}` : missing;\n    return `missing required property '${fieldPath}'`;\n  }\n  const fieldLabel = basePath || 'input';\n  if (error.keyword === 'type') {\n    const rawType = params.type;\n    const expectedType = Array.isArray(rawType) ? rawType.join(' | ') : String(rawType ?? 'unknown');\n    return `property '${fieldLabel}' must be of type ${expectedType}`;\n  }\n  if (error.keyword === 'enum') {\n    const allowedValues = params.allowedValues;\n    if (Array.isArray(allowedValues)) {\n      const choices = allowedValues.map(choice => JSON.stringify(choice)).join(', ');\n      return `property '${fieldLabel}' must be one of: ${choices}`;\n    }\n    return `property '${fieldLabel}' failed enum`;\n  }\n  return `property '${fieldLabel}' ${error.message ?? error.keyword}`;\n}\n\nfunction normalizeAjvPath(rawPath: string): string {\n  if (!rawPath) return '';\n  if (rawPath.startsWith('/')) {\n    const segments = rawPath.slice(1).split('/');\n    return segments.map(segment => segment.replace(/~1/g, '/').replace(/~0/g, '~')).join('.');\n  }\n  return rawPath.startsWith('.') ? source() : source;\n  }\n\n  register(definition: ToolDefinitionSource, execute: ToolExecutor): void {\n    const resolved = this.resolveDefinition(definition);\n    const validator = typeof definition === 'function' ? undefined : compileSchema(resolved.name, resolved.inputSchema);\n    this.tools.set(resolved.name, {definitionSource: definition, execute, validator});\n  }\n\n  get(name: string): RegisteredTool | undefined {\n    const tool = this.tools.get(name);\n    if (!tool) return undefined;\n    return {definition: this.resolveDefinition(tool.definitionSource), execute: tool.execute};\n  }\n\n  getDefinitions(): ToolDefinition[] {\n    return [...this.tools.values()].map(t => this.resolveDefinition(t.definitionSource));\n  }\n\n  getPromptInstructions(): string[] {\n    return this.getDefinitions()\n      .filter(t => t.promptInstructions)\n      .map(t => `${t.name}: ${t.promptInstructions}`);\n  }\n\n  getExamplePrompts(): string[] {\n    return this.getDefinitions().flatMap(t => t.examplePrompts ?? []);\n  }\n\n  has(name: string): boolean {\n    return this.tools.has(name);\n  }\n\n  async execute(name: string, input: Record<string, unknown>, context?: ToolContext): Promise<ToolResponse> {\n    const tool = this.tools.get(name);\n    if (!tool) {\n      log.warn('tool', 'tool not found', {name});\n      throw new Error(`Unknown tool: ${name}`);\n    }\n    this.resolveValidator(tool);\n    log.info('tool', 'executing', {name, inputKeys: Object.keys(input)});\n    const rawResult = await tool.execute(input, context);\n    const response = normalizeToolResponse(rawResult);\n    log.info('tool', 'execution complete', {\n      name,\n      rawType: typeof rawResult,\n      clientMessageCount: response.clientMessages?.length ?? 0,\n      clientMessageTypes: response.clientMessages?.map(m => m.type) ?? [],\n      suppressAssistantResponse: response.suppressAssistantResponse ?? false,\n    });\n    return response;\n  }\n\n  private resolveValidator(tool: StoredTool): ValidateFunction {\n    if (tool.validator) return tool.validator;\n    const resolved = this.resolveDefinition(tool.definitionSource);\n    const cached = this.dynamicValidators.get(resolved.inputSchema);\n    if (cached) return cached;\n    const compiled = compileSchema(resolved.name, resolved.inputSchema);\n    this.dynamicValidators.set(resolved.inputSchema, compiled);\n    return compiled;\n  }\n}\n\nfunction compileSchema(toolName: string, inputSchema: Record<string, unknown>): ValidateFunction {\n  try {\n    return ajv.compile(inputSchema as SchemaObject);\n  } catch (error) {\n    const reason = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);\n    throw new Error(`Invalid inputSchema for tool \"${toolName}\": ${reason}`);\n  }\n}","file_path":"/var/tmp/loop-bench/runs/40ff4f589217/workspace/target/src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts"}}
